title: SMART Goals — Specific, Measurable, Attainable, Realistic, Time-Bound
skills: define the components of a SMART goal
write goals that are specific, measurable, attainable, realistic, and time-bound
evaluate whether a goal is clear and actionable
use structured goal setting to support writing progress and academic growth
alignment_note: Introduces the SMART goal framework for creating clear, measurable, realistic, and time-bound objectives. Supports writing goals, self-evaluation, metacognition, academic planning, progress monitoring, and student ownership of learning across high school English courses.
